summary: Clean Harbors filed an 8-K announcing the completion of its acquisition of Terra Nova Solutions for $225 million in cash, funded from available cash. The target is a regional hazardous/non-hazardous waste services provider with five sites in the Carolinas. Clean Harbors expects $45-50M annual revenue, ~$15M Adj. EBITDA, and $4M of synergies post-first year, implying an 11.8x post-synergy multiple. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The acquisition enhances the company's Technical and Field Services businesses. Watch for integration progress and synergy realization in the next fiscal year; risk-arb is minimal as the deal is closed.
